title: Dan Ives Talks New Moves in the AI Revolution
description: After leaving Wedbush, Dan Ives has launched a new merchant bank that he says will deliver the same research he's known for, but with people who want to innovate and grow in this "Fourth Industrial Revolution." The wide-ranging conversation touches on AI skepticism, China's role in the AI industry, and why he sees the AI industry going to heights that we may not yet be able to see. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Cerebras Shares Tumble After Sales Decline at Hardware Business
description: Cerebras Systems Inc. slid in late trading after reporting a decline in hardware revenue, a sign the newly public company is making slow progress selling computers with a novel chip design.

title: Cisco’s Sales Top Estimates, But Fail to Live Up to the Hype
description: Cisco Systems Inc. delivered quarterly revenue and profit that beat estimates, but failed to live up to investors’ high expectations following blow-out results in the previous period.
